raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Add a worker RPC `reload_draft_weights(weights_path=...)` that reloads the speculative draft model's weights in place from a new checkpoint, so a drafter that keeps training while vLLM serves (online speculative decoding) can be swapped in without restarting the engine or touching the target model.

Closes #60138

- `GPUModelRunner.reload_draft_weights(weights_iterator=None, weights_path=None)` mirrors `reload_weights`: resolves the draft through `get_draft_model()`, updates `speculative_config.draft_model_config.model`, loads through the draft's model loader with `initialize_layerwise_reload` / `finalize_layerwise_reload` (in place, parameter addresses captured by CUDA graphs are preserved), and re-runs the dflash fused-buffer rebuild if the drafter has one.
- Draft submodules that are live target objects (the embedding shared by EAGLE drafters, the lm_head aliased by MTP drafters) are detached while the checkpoint loads (`_detach_target_owned_draft_modules`), so a draft checkpoint that ships those tensors cannot overwrite target storage.
- `Worker.reload_draft_weights` passthrough; Model Runner V2 delegates to V1 like `reload_weights`.
- Docs: `docs/features/speculative_decoding/eagle.md` gains a "Reloading an Updated Draft Model" section (offline `collective_rpc` and the `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE` HTTP endpoint).

**Not a duplicate of #52487.** That PR reloads the draft from its *configured* path inside `reload_weights()` to fix the Level-2 sleep/wake regression (#52479). This PR adds the *new-path* swap for online-trained speculators as a separate method, leaving `reload_weights` untouched; both use `get_draft_model()` and the same "detach target-owned modules" idea, so a shared helper is a straightforward follow-up once #52487 lands.

## Test Plan

- Unit (CPU): `pytest tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py -k TestReloadDraftWeights`
  - new-path reload updates the draft config and loads only the draft (target `load_weights` never called);
  - `draft_load_config` is used when set; iterator path skips the loader; `ValueError` without a draft;
  - V2 runner delegates to V1;
  - a draft checkpoint that ships the shared embedding leaves the target embedding untouched and the shared module re-attached (real `nn.Module`s through `AutoWeightsLoader`).
- E2E (GPU): `pytest tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/eagle/test_reload_draft_weights.py`
  - Qwen3-8B + `AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3` (run locally; the Llama-3.1 EAGLE3 pair is parametrized for CI, I cannot access the gated model): generate greedily, reload a copy of the draft whose `lm_head` is zeroed, check outputs are unchanged (lossless) and acceptance length drops; reload the original path, check acceptance is restored.

## Test Result

- Unit: `4 passed in 4.75s` on main; the same tests pass against a backport of the branch onto vLLM 0.27.1.
- E2E (H100, Qwen3-8B + `AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3`, main @ 2e3154a with the branch applied, nightly cu130 wheel): `1 passed` in 3 min — outputs byte-identical across the two reloads; acceptance length drops with the zeroed head and is restored with the original. The same test also passes against a backport of the branch onto vLLM 0.27.1 (`1 passed`).
- Serving check (vLLM 0.27.1 + backport of this branch, `vllm serve` with `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`, EAGLE3 k=3, 256 concurrent code-generation streams on one H100): a co-located trainer adapted the head to the new domain on ~800 served requests in 25 s and exported four heads; each was loaded through `POST /collective_rpc {"method": "reload_draft_weights", ...}` in 0.67–0.72 s while requests kept flowing. Served acceptance length rose from 1.92 to 2.65 (static head: 2.12 throughout); in steady state the server generated +24% tokens/s vs the static deployment (bench over the phase: 17629 vs 14461 output tok/s, median TPOT 13.6 vs 16.9 ms), with greedy outputs unchanged.
- Tensor parallelism (added 2026-10-09; vLLM 0.27.1 + backport, `vllm serve -tp 2` and `-tp 4`, Qwen3-8B, 64 concurrent code streams): reloading a code-adapted head raised acceptance length 2.12 → 2.72 and throughput +26% at both TP=2 (10024 → 12592 tok/s, 0.74 s) and TP=4 (13520 → 17084 tok/s, 0.90 s); reloading the original head restored the original numbers. Exactness under TP=2 (32 prompts, greedy, 128 tokens): re-running with the same head is byte-identical, and so is a reload of the *same* checkpoint, i.e. the reload itself is exact; reloading a head whose `lm_head` is zeroed changed one token in one prompt at position 101, because verification numerics are not batch-invariant under TP once every draft is rejected. For that reason the e2e test keeps its byte-exact assertion at TP=1 only.

## Model evaluation

Greedy outputs are byte-identical before/after reload in the e2e test (verification is lossless, so only the acceptance length changes). Online adaptation of the AngelSlim Qwen3-8B EAGLE3 head on served traffic raises acceptance length 1.88→2.63 (SQL), 2.12→2.72 (code), 1.91→2.37 (chat) after 3200 requests; at concurrency 256 that moves speculation from 0.93× to 1.07–1.17× of no-speculation throughput — the benefit this RPC lets a running server pick up.

## AI assistance

This PR was developed with AI assistance (Claude); every changed line was reviewed and the tests above were run by the submitter. `pre-commit`/`ruff` pass on the changed files.

 ```
 
+## Reloading an Updated Draft Model
+
+A draft model that keeps training while vLLM serves (for example on the live
+request stream) can be swapped into the running engine without a restart and
+without touching the target model, by calling `reload_draft_weights` on the
+workers. With the offline API:
+
+```python
+llm.collective_rpc("reload_draft_weights", kwargs={"weights_path": "/path/to/new-draft"})
+```
+
+With an online server started with `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`:
+
+```bash
+curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/collective_rpc \
+    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+    -d '{"method": "reload_draft_weights", "kwargs": {"weights_path": "/path/to/new-draft"}}'
+```
+
+The new checkpoint must have the same architecture as the configured draft
+model; omitting `weights_path` reloads from the configured path. Submodules the
+drafter shares with the target model (such as the embedding) are left untouched.
+
 ## Pre-Trained Eagle Draft Models
 
 A variety of EAGLE draft models are available on the Hugging Face hub:

@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Swap draft weights in a running engine: outputs stay those of the target
+(verification is lossless) while the acceptance length tracks the draft quality."""
+
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+from safetensors.torch import load_file, save_file
+
+from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
+
+from ..utils import get_test_prompts
+
+
+def _spec_decode_counters(llm: LLM) -> dict[str, float]:
+    counters: dict[str, float] = {}
+    for metric in llm.get_metrics():
+        if "spec_decode" in metric.name and hasattr(metric, "value"):
+            counters[metric.name] = counters.get(metric.name, 0.0) + metric.value
+    return counters
+
+
+def _mean_acceptance_length(llm: LLM, prompts, sampling_params) -> tuple[float, list]:
+    before = _spec_decode_counters(llm)
+    outputs = llm.chat(prompts, sampling_params)
+    after = _spec_decode_counters(llm)
+    delta = {k: after.get(k, 0.0) - before.get(k, 0.0) for k in after}
+    drafts = sum(v for k, v in delta.items() if k.endswith("spec_decode_num_drafts"))
+    accepted = sum(
+        v for k, v in delta.items() if k.endswith("spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens")
+    )
+    assert drafts > 0
+    return 1.0 + accepted / drafts, [o.outputs[0].token_ids for o in outputs]
+
+
+def _degraded_draft_checkpoint(draft_model: str, out_dir: Path) -> Path:
+    """Copy the draft checkpoint with its lm_head zeroed (the drafter then proposes
+    the same token everywhere, so almost nothing is accepted)."""
+    src = Path(snapshot_download(draft_model))
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for name in ("config.json", "generation_config.json"):
+        if (src / name).exists():
+            shutil.copy(src / name, out_dir / name)
+    tensors: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for f in sorted(src.glob("*.safetensors")):
+        tensors.update(load_file(str(f)))
+    for f in sorted(src.glob("*.bin")):
+        tensors.update(torch.load(str(f), map_location="cpu", weights_only=True))
+    head_keys = [k for k in tensors if k.endswith("lm_head.weight")]
+    assert head_keys, f"no lm_head in {draft_model}: {list(tensors)[:5]}"
+    for k in head_keys:
+        tensors[k] = torch.zeros_like(tensors[k])
+    save_file(
+        {k: v.contiguous() for k, v in tensors.items()},
+        str(out_dir / "model.safetensors"),
+        metadata={"format": "pt"},
+    )
+    return out_dir
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("model_name", "draft_model"),
+    [
+        ("Qwen/Qwen3-8B", "AngelSlim/Qwen3-8B_eagle3"),
+        ("meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct", "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B"),
+    ],
+    ids=["qwen3_eagle3", "llama3_eagle3"],
+)
+def test_reload_draft_weights(tmp_path: Path, model_name: str, draft_model: str):
+    prompts = get_test_prompts(mm_enabled=False)[:16]
+    sampling_params = SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=64)
+    llm = LLM(
+        model=model_name,
+        speculative_config={
+            "method": "eagle3",
+            "model": draft_model,
+            "num_speculative_tokens": 3,
+            "max_model_len": 2048,
+        },
+        max_model_len=2048,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.8,
+        disable_log_stats=False,
+    )
+    acc_original, ref_outputs = _mean_acceptance_length(llm, prompts, sampling_params)
+    assert acc_original > 1.5
+
+    degraded = _degraded_draft_checkpoint(draft_model, tmp_path / "degraded")
+    llm.collective_rpc("reload_draft_weights", kwargs={"weights_path": str(degraded)})
+    acc_degraded, outputs = _mean_acceptance_length(llm, prompts, sampling_params)
+    assert outputs == ref_outputs, "reloading the draft changed target outputs"
+    assert acc_degraded < acc_original - 0.5
+
+    llm.collective_rpc("reload_draft_weights", kwargs={"weights_path": draft_model})
+    acc_restored, outputs = _mean_acceptance_length(llm, prompts, sampling_params)
+    assert outputs == ref_outputs
+    assert abs(acc_restored - acc_original) < 0.1

+    def test_reload_from_new_path_loads_only_the_draft(self):

+        draft_config = runner.speculative_config.draft_model_config
+        assert draft_config.model == "draft/updated"
+        assert draft_config.revision is None

+        finalize_reload.assert_called_once_with(draft_model, draft_config)
+
+    def test_reload_without_draft_model_raises(self):
+        runner = self._make_runner()
+        runner.get_draft_model = Mock(return_value=None)
+
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No speculative draft model"):
+            runner.reload_draft_weights(weights_path="draft/updated")
+
+    def test_v2_runner_delegates_to_v1(self):
+        runner = self._make_runner(GPUModelRunnerV2)

+        self._reload(runner, draft_model, iter([]), weights_path="draft/updated")
+
+        draft_model.load_weights.assert_called_once()
+        assert runner.speculative_config.draft_model_config.model == "draft/updated"

+    def test_reload_never_writes_target_owned_submodules(self):

+        self._reload(runner, draft_model, weights, weights_path="draft/updated")

+        assert draft_model.embed_tokens is target_model.embed_tokens
+        assert torch.equal(target_model.embed_tokens.weight, original_embed)
+        assert torch.equal(draft_model.fc.weight, torch.eye(4))

+        touching the target model: draft submodules that are live target objects

+        drafters) are detached while the checkpoint is loaded.

+            weights_iterator: weights to load into the draft model.
+            weights_path: checkpoint to load from when ``weights_iterator`` is

+
+        Raises:
+            ValueError: if no speculative draft model is loaded.

+        get_draft_model = getattr(self, "get_draft_model", None)

+            raise ValueError("No speculative draft model is loaded")

+        assert draft_model_config is not None

+            draft_model_config.model = weights_path

+            draft_model.load_weights(weights_iterator)

+        # of load_weights (dflash) rebuilt them on meta tensors inside the

+            time.perf_counter() - counter_before_reloading,

🚀

Friendly ping for the speculative-decoding owners (@benchislett @luccafong @MatthewBonanni), since the auto-assignment only picked the worker/gpu owners: this adds a `reload_draft_weights` worker RPC so an EAGLE/MTP drafter that keeps training while vLLM serves can be swapped in without restarting the engine. It is independent of #52487 (new-path swap vs. re-reading the configured path on wake-up) and both use the same "detach target-owned submodules while loading" idea, so a shared helper is a natural follow-up once that lands.

Since opening the PR I have run it in a closed loop on an H100 (vLLM 0.27.1 + this patch, Qwen3-8B + AngelSlim EAGLE-3, 256 concurrent code requests, 9000 unique prompts): a co-located trainer adapted the head on the served traffic and four reloads of 0.7 s each took acceptance length 2.1 → 2.67 and throughput +17–18% at saturation, with greedy outputs unchanged. Happy to split, rename or rework anything; the `pre-run-check` failure is the new-contributor gate, so a `ready` label would let CI speak.
